test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 27 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Arpan, Lohit, Vinayak, Kripal and Ashraf are watching a movie. All are sitting in a line facing the screen. Kripal is to the immediate left of Ashraf. Vinayak is to the immediate left of Arpan. Lohit is second to the left of Arpan. Kripal is sitting at one of the corners. Who is sitting to the immediate right of Ashraf?
solution:
**Five friend: **Arpan, Lohit, Vinayak, Kripal and Ashraf.

1) Kripal is sitting at one of the corners.

(Assume that they all facing towards north)

(Here is two cases are possible for sitting arrangement)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fbc0b4fa0c6809697c790990c52aa329c5e61b11d175d22249a810d4d5eb668f.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1551176c5f648ef11381f53b9196cc6a275a8f376de762e44e746054f7633679.png] 

2) Kripal is to the immediate left of Ashraf.

(From this statement Case - 2 is eliminated, because in Case - 2 Kripal is sitting in right extreme end and it is not possible that Kripal is sitting immediate right of Ashraf)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/160c30841de4191972bee50200a873df0c6aa4ad7e8a9c8c1d9f3fdc2d53d29f.png] 

3) Lohit is second to the left of Arpan.

(According to this statement Arpan has to sit extreme right end, Because Lohit is second to the left of Arpan. It is possible when Arpan sit Right extreme end)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/585a041eb7a27c5b539493c4fcef288480c9958525376c156283cffd627c27e8.png] 

4) Only one place are left on which Vinayak will sit.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/75b48cc14fd7e1b56838b0f611ed22b9c235396286be83d7a8e28ed5ee3d9277.png] 

According to final sitting arrangement **Lohit **is sitting immediate right of **Ashraf.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Lohit".**
